newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to softer.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to softer.

text.p: One week to one month Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were lower while the rest were steady, traders said on Monday.
A trader said the adjustment in the short-term rates reflected a short-term impact of the high liquidity in the market.
Banks have been awash with pesos because they have been discouraged from investing their money in term reverse repos because of a 20 percent tax.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks were willing to swap their pesos with dollars.
